facts.fact: The Ministry of Health reports that its health information directorate (DIS), under director Chehem Ibrahim, led the DHIS2 project from design through physical installation to operation, with a steering committee and a technical team set up to manage and coordinate it, as presented to the minister on 12 November 2020.

The Ministry of Health reports that the DHIS2 introduction began with a roadmap carrying a budget and a timetable for putting DHIS2 in place, as recounted by the DIS director on 12 November 2020; the roadmap's own date and period are not given.

The DIS director confirmed on 12 November 2020 that DHIS2 was operational at levels 1 and 2 of the health pyramid, end users having been trained at the CSC and CMH, with routine data reaching the DIS through it; integration of level 3, the hospitals, was still being studied.

The Ministry of Health reports that end users at the CSC and CMH were trained on DHIS2, followed by data-entry workshops and post-training supervision visits, and that by 12 November 2020 routine data rose through the platform to the DIS; it gives no count of facilities entering.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Direction de l'information sanitaire (DIS)
systems.tiers: levels 1 and 2 of the health pyramid, end users at the CSC and CMH; level 3 (hospitals) under study; vertical programmes and the parapublic and private sectors a later ambition (12 November 2020)

note: Classed hmis on the document's own description: an electronic system for routine health data, collected, compiled, analysed and disseminated. The tier value is a mapping the parent should check: the document says levels 1 and 2 and names CSC and CMH without expanding either, and says level 3 is the hospitals; T3 is given for CSC as health centres and T2 for CMH as first-referral facilities, and whether level 1 also covers health posts (T4) is not stated. Facility entry is read from end users being trained at those facilities and data-entry workshops, not from an explicit statement of where keying happens. The implementation is dated about a year before the meeting. No finance source is stated.
